title: APIs and enterprise integrations
summary: Connecting a system to the customer's systems of record: HTTP, JSON and OAuth 2.0, webhooks and Kafka events, and integrating with or migrating off legacy systems.
intro: Forward deployed work lives or dies on connecting an AI system to the customer's real systems of record: CRMs, ERPs, ticketing tools, event buses and decades-old databases. This module covers the request/response contract (HTTP, JSON, OAuth 2.0), the push and streaming contract (webhooks and Kafka), and the patterns for integrating with and migrating off legacy systems without breaking the business.

lessons.title: REST APIs, JSON and OAuth 2.0 authentication
Webhooks and event-driven integrations with Kafka
Integrating legacy systems and running migrations
